# VIDPOD
> VIDPOD is a Melbourne video and podcast production company, founded by Tommy Jackett, working with organisations right across Australia.

## Services
- [Corporate video production Melbourne](https://www.vidpod.com.au/video-production-melbourne): brand videos, founder stories, explainers and animation, product videos and social content, made by one team from first chat to final film.
- [Case study video production Melbourne](https://www.vidpod.com.au/video-case-studies-melbourne): customer case study and testimonial videos, including a series for a whole network, like the @Pilates franchisees.
- [Video podcast production Melbourne](https://www.vidpod.com.au/video-podcast-production-melbourne): filming in your office, on campus or in a studio, editing, clips and Shorts, internal and members-only shows and remote recording. For a few shows, we also build and run the show website and everything around it, as we do for The Numbers Game.
